scope: Exactly five Chinese-only corrections; each original English sentence is an immutable write guard.

facts.sentenceEn: The girl died from head injuries.
facts.reason: Head injuries do not necessarily mean brain injuries.

facts.sentenceEn: She needs additional time to finish her science project this weekend.
facts.before: 她這個週末需要額外的時間才能完成科展作品。
facts.after: 她這個週末需要額外的時間才能完成她的科學專題。
facts.reason: Science project does not specify participation in a science fair.

facts.sentenceEn: She worked hard for ten years to realize her dream of opening a bakery.
facts.before: 她努力了十年，終於實現了開一家麵包店的夢想。
facts.after: 為了實現開一家麵包店的夢想，她努力了十年。
facts.reason: The purpose infinitive does not independently assert that the goal was achieved.

facts.sentenceEn: The new model is far better than the old one.
facts.before: 新型號比起舊的還要好。
facts.after: 新型號比舊型號好得多。
facts.reason: Far before the comparative explicitly indicates a large degree.

facts.sentenceEn: This shirt isn't big enough for him anymore.
facts.before: 這件襯衫對他來說已經不夠大了。
facts.after: 這件上衣對他來說已經不夠大了。
facts.reason: Shirt includes the round-neck T-shirt actually shown; remove the unsupported collared-shirt specificity.
